title: A Routine Unit Conversion Left a Plane 55% Short
hook: One routine unit conversion left a plane 55% short on fuel.
closing: Unit checks feel tedious until one missed conversion puts lives at risk.
question: Should everyone use metric?

segments.say: Only 5 percent of people live in non-metric countries, yet those holdouts still create conversion risks.
A unit mix-up dropped the Mars orbiter to 57 kilometers, far below its planned path.
A unit error left the plane 55 percent short on fuel, forcing it to glide down.
